pages.text: A VARIABLE line has a name, a type and an optional start value. Without one, it holds the default: false, 0, 0.0, a space, an empty text or list.$(br2)A CONSTANT line looks the same, but it must have a value. You can't change it later.
$(1)VARIABLE b BOOLEAN TRUE$(br)VARIABLE i INTEGER$(br)CONSTANT BASE INTEGER 42$()
Lists, hashes and structs get their start values in a code block. Each line holds literals or a key and a value:
$(1)VARIABLE list ARRAY INTEGER$(br)BEGIN$(br)  1 2 3$(br)END VARIABLE$(br)VARIABLE stock HASH INTEGER$(br)BEGIN$(br)  gold 1$(br)END VARIABLE$()
